description: This file contains utility functions for extracting probability metrics from various speech-to-text (STT) service result objects, including Whisper, GPT-4o, and Deepgram. The functions parse the results to compute confidence probabilities based on different formats used by these services.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_whisper_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts the probability/confidence from a Whisper-based TranscriptionFrame, converting avg_logprob to a probability value.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_openai_gpt4o_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts the probability/confidence from an OpenAI GPT-4o-transcribe TranscriptionFrame, computing the average of logprobs and converting to a probability.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_deepgram_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts the probability/confidence from a Deepgram TranscriptionFrame, using alternative-level confidence or computing average word confidences.
